Description

The legendary dragon of the ice and snow. Despite her small stature, she's quite dangerous.

Defense

AC 36, touch 26, flat-footed 21 (+10 natural, +14 dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)

hp 551 [760] (19d12+152)

mp 144

Fort +19, Ref +27, Will +21

Absorb Ice

DR 10/magic

Immune Ability Drain, Charmed, Cowering, Death, Diseased, Energy Drain, Entangled, Exhausted, Fatigued, Frightened, Frog, Frozen, Immobilized, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Panicked, Paralysis, Petrify, Shaken, Silence, Sleep, Staggered, Stop, Stunned, Zombie

Resist wind 50%

SR 27

Weakness Fire

Offense

Speed 50 ft., burrow 30 ft., swim 50 ft.

Melee Bite +30 (2d8+15 plus 2d6 ice damage), 2 claws +30 (2d6+10 plus 1d8 ice damage)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)

Special Attacks Absolute Zero, Avalanche, Breath Weapon (50-ft. cone, 14d10 ice damage, Reflex DC 27 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Hailstorm, Northern Cross, Snowstorm

Burst Mode Frostbite

Spells Known (FC CL 19th, concentration +27)

0th (DC 18) - Bleed, Detect Magic, Mending, Message, Read Magic

1st (DC 19) - Blizzard, Frostbite, Icicle Dagger, Slick

2nd (DC 20) - Blizzard II, Elemental Resistance, Frigid Touch, Frost Fall, Icy Breath, Slick II

3rd (DC 21) - Blizzara, Blizzard III, Ice Spears, Sleet Storm, Slick III

4th (DC 22) - Blizzard IV, Ice Spikes, Ice Storm

5th (DC 23) - Blizzaga, Cone of Cold, Freeze, Icy Prison, Wall of Ice

6th (DC 24) - Freezing Sphere, Glacier, Ice Spikes II, Icy Blast

7th (DC 25) - Freeze II, Ice Body

8th (DC 26) - Glacier II, Ice Spikes III, Polar Ray

9th (DC 27) - Iceburg, Mass Icy Prison, Polar Midnight

Statistics

Str 30, Dex 38, Con 26, Int 22, Wis 26, Cha 18

Base Atk +19; CMB +28; CMD 53 (57 vs. trip)

Feats Canny Tumble, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Great Cleave, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, Power Attack, Spring Attack

Skills Acrobatics +19, Appraise +29, Bluff +27, Intimidate +27, Knowledge (arcana) +29, Knowledge (geography) +29, Knowledge (history) +29, Perception +31, Sense Motive +31, Spellcraft +29, Stealth +41, Swim +41; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim

Languages Auroran, Common, Draconic plus 4 more

SQ Beatdown, Icewalking, Ice Shape

description.value: [phase i] Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, Ice Dragon takes a deep breath and releases it in a sigh, and as she does so, the very air itself around her begins to freeze. For 1 minute, all creatures who come within a 30 ft. radius of Ice Dragon take 30 ice damage that ignores immunity and resistance, and must make a Fortitude save (DC 27) or be Frozen for 1 minute. Creatures who are already Frozen when taking damage from this aura have the duration of the effect, if any, refreshed. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33). During Phase II, reduce cooldown to 1d2+1 rounds.

description.value: [phase i] Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Ice Dragon creates a mass of snow and ice that crashes onto a 30 ft.-radius which is 60 ft. high. This deals 10d8 points of ice damage must make a Reflex save (DC 27) and affects every creature and object that takes damage as if hit with a bull rush with a CMB of 29. All creatures and objects moved by the bull rush are pushed directly away from the center of the spell. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 29). During Ice Dragon's death, she will use as she dies as an immediate action.

description.value: [phase i] Ice dragon can shape ice and snow at will. This ability functions as stone shape, but only targeting ice and snow, not stone. Ice dragon's caster level for this effect is equal to its Hit Dice.

description.value: [phase i] This ability works like the spider climb spell, but the surfaces the dragon climbs must be icy. The dragon can move across icy surfaces without penalty and does not need to make Acrobatics checks to run or charge on ice.

[phase i] Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, the Ice Dragon will summon a 30 ft.-radius blizzard in a select area completely freezing all those who fail their Fortitude save (DC 27). Every target can be trapped in solid ice 19 inches thick. If the creature fails its save, it is helpless, but can still breathe (the ice blocks line of effect to the target). If the target makes its save, it gains the entangled condition but can otherwise act normally. Whether or not the target saves, it takes 19 points of ice damage each round it is helpless or entangled in the ice. The ice has hardness 0 and 105 hit points; if broken, the creature is freed. A creature can break the ice as a full-round action with a successful Strength check (DC 29) or Escape Artist skill check (DC 34). Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).
